capabilities: Create paginated handwritten notes with page templates and margins
Annotate PDFs and extract excerpts to a scratchpad
Draw on an infinite canvas with text, ink, and cards
Link handwritten regions with Markdown notes and embed text in drawings
Export drawings as PDF, PNG, or restorable editable backups
extras: Interface is only in Simplified Chinese; mobile is unverified. The main script is about 46 MB, exceeding the 5 MB per-file limit of Obsidian Sync Standard, so it must be installed separately on each device with that plan. Free, MIT-licensed, offline, no account or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's native editor only handles typed Markdown, with no way to handwrite on pages, draw freely, or annotate PDFs stored in the vault.

relations.evidence: 绘图内核使用 Excalidraw，图标使用 Lucide

summary: Handwriting plugin that adds paginated ink notes, PDF annotation, an infinite canvas, and a docked scratchpad alongside regular Markdown notes.
